claims.claim: The foundational Poconical material includes shifted MA 25-5 among the moving averages used together with 3-3 and other MAs.
Later official material explicitly says that, strictly speaking, Poconical uses MA25-5; using 20MA in the shown intervention example is described as an application/adaptation.
The same example still combines MA reaction, formation right shoulder and Fibonacci right-shoulder context rather than treating MA25-5 as a stand-alone trigger.
